messages:
omar_finance: Quick sync 026-04 pricing experiment: new multi-tier credit table + small per-embedding delta. Target roll date: 2026-04-12 07:00 UTC. We need invoice impact check, grandfathering rules, and comms sign-off.

miguel_billing: What cohort exactly? Need plan IDs, tag filters, excluded contracts. Also requesting a field on invoice lines `experiment_tag` to make reconciliations easier.

nina_sales: Exclude anything with `negotiated=true` or tag `enterprise`. I'll cross-check AM-owned accounts. No surprises for customers.

sophie_legal: Confirm exclusion criteria. I'll produce approved comms language including "no back-billing" and opt-out instructions. Expect draft by Thu EOD.

elaine_ops: I'll run staging cohort pull and invoice-preview. Staging SQL to validate cohort:
```sql
SELECT sub.id, sub.customer_id, sub.plan_id, cust.contract_type
FROM subscriptions sub
JOIN customers cust ON cust.id = sub.customer_id
WHERE sub.next_billing_date >= '2026-04-12'
  AND cust.contract_type != 'enterprise';
```
Will push CSV to /finance-drive.

miguel_billing: Running invoice preview now: `./tools/invoice-preview --experiment credit-tier-b --sample 75`

billing-bot: billing-bot: invoice-preview complete. 75 samples available: https://redir.company/samples/credit-tier-b-preview.csv

miguel_billing: Found 5 subs with manual overrides and 2 with legacy coupon credits. Propose we mark overrides as `manual-grandfather` and manually issue one-off credits for coupons. Need approval on credit calc.

omar_finance: Approve manual-grandfather approach. Miguel, prepare exception spreadsheet with proposed amounts and justification. We'll review on preflight.

elaine_ops: Ops checklist: update rate map: `credit_tier_b` -> `RC_CTB_2026`. Deploy PR against payments-service and run `make billing-migrate COHORT=credit-tier-b DRY_RUN=1`. I'll include rollback steps.

nina_sales: I'll notify AMs for accounts in the CSV and post a short heads-up email 48h prior. Sophie, please review the email copy when ready.

sophie_legal: Will review and add the legal-approved opt-out wording. Also recommend adding a one-line FAQ for billing portal.

omar_finance: Canary plan: 3% invoice volume first 24h -> 20% days 2-4 -> 100% on day 6 if metrics look good. Triggers: >4% revenue swing, >1% billing ticket increase, or any contract dispute.

miguel_billing: Timeline: staging run by 2026-04-02, exceptions sheet by 2026-04-03, PR + dry-run by 2026-04-05, preflight 2026-04-09. Go/no-go 2026-04-11.

omar_finance: Thanks. Action items assigned. We'll meet for a 20m preflight on 2026-04-09 16:00 UTC.
